title: ARRI ALEXA 265 Large-Format Digital Cinema Camera
purpose: 65mm large-format digital cinema vista with immense resolving power, clean low-noise signal, and organic film-like highlight roll-off.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: ARRI ALEXA 265 Large-Format Digital Cinema Camera
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 65mm large-format digital cinema sensor (54.12x25.58mm active area)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~28mm wide vista field of view on 65mm format
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15 stops dynamic latitude with gentle LogC highlight roll-off

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Cinematic feature production lighting, balanced naturalistic key and ambient fill with organic highlight roll-off
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Gentle highlight roll-off, subtle specular dispersion, rich shadow gradient without noise crush

surface_rendering: Vast 65mm cinema detail: high micro-acutance on landscapes, architecture, and skin textures without digital edge ringing
Natural film-like color science with authentic skin tones and subdued organic saturation
Extremely clean low-noise digital capture with gentle texture fidelity
depth_and_optics: Shallow depth of field characteristic of 65mm large-format sensors even at wide focal lengths
Sublime optical separation and three-dimensional subject isolation
Impeccable rectilinear projection with gentle optical illumination fall-off

execution_directive: Enforce large-format 65mm digital cinema frame. Vast wide vista with immense detail, clean low-noise image, gentle highlight roll-off, natural film-like color, shallow depth of field despite the wide view, shot on ARRI ALEXA 265.
